Academics
Doctoral Degrees
Our doctoral programs are designed to transform passionate researchers through rigorous research, interdisciplinary collaboration, and mentorship from world-class faculty. The University of Pittsburgh, named one of the top public research institutions in the country, offers an interdisciplinary and collaborative environment where you’ll have the opportunity to participate in federally funded research and work with faculty members who are experts in their fields.
PhD Programs
Computer Science
Collaborate with other domains and also research ways to improve the networks, the operating systems, and the multitude of devices that are integrated into our daily lives.
Explore a PhD in CS
Information Science
Explore the intersection of information and technology, receive interdisciplinary training, conduct high-impact research, and pursue and succeed in careers in both higher education and industry.
Explore a PhD in IS
Intelligent Systems
Gain an advanced knowledge in intelligent systems through interdisciplinary research and collaboration across other schools at the University of Pittsburgh.
Explore a PhD in ISP
Library and Information Science
Develop an understanding of library and information science beyond a master’s degree, with particular emphasis on the conduct of original research, the production of significant research findings, and the contribution of such findings to public knowledge.
Explore a PhD in LIS
